title: The theory chooses the boundary of the conscious system

statements.text: The theorem restricts the global state to a region $R$ conditionally: $R$ is whatever bounded system, such as a brain, computer, network or mechanism, the theory under test assigns consciousness to. The account itself specifies the target system.

standing.reason: A limit the paper states: the theorem takes the boundary from the theory and does not derive it.

sources.quote: The account itself thereby specifies the target system.
